A1.justification: Both complete, readable 51-page PDFs describe the same DF3DV-1K dataset, benchmark, and DI2FIX work. Text and visual comparison establishes that the entire appendix, pages 23–51, is identical.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmarking, DI2FIX training and evaluation, ablations, and statistical analyses in Sections 4 and S.2–S.3.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark scores, enhancement experiments, and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: DI2FIX retains the same DIFIX architecture, rendered-reference input, LPIPS-filtered training pairs, and disabled Gram-matrix loss (Sections 4.2 and S.3). No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both use the same DF3DV-1K data, DF3DV-41 subset, RobustNeRF, and On-the-go datasets. The indoor/outdoor coverage and 17 challenging scenario categories are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains 3DGS and the same nine distractor-free variants. The enhancer comparisons retain DIFIX and DIFIX+RobustNeRF alongside DI2FIX (Tables 4 and S.6); no comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Preprocessing, training configurations, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics, training subsets, filtering thresholds, and leave-one-method-out evaluation remain unchanged (Sections 4 and S.2–S.3).

E4.justification: Both retain the dataset-scale and filtering-threshold ablations, scenario-wise robustness analyses, view-dependent-object evaluation, cross-method generalization tests, and DI2FIX failure cases (Tables 5–6 and S.2–S.7; Figure S.15).

E5.justification: The paired t-tests across scenes and significance-reporting procedure in Section S.2 and Table S.1 are identical. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results, rankings, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 4 retains Vanilla/DI2FIX PSNR values of 20.82/21.78 dB and LPIPS values of 0.211/0.154. Supplementary result tables and images also match exactly.

T1.justification: No mathematical definitions, formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added, removed, or revised. The mathematical content is unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same dataset, benchmarking, and generalizable-enhancement contributions, including the reported 0.96 dB PSNR gain and 0.057 LPIPS reduction.

C2.justification: Interpretations of difficult distractor scenarios, dataset-scale benefits, and perceptual tradeoffs are retained. The same limitations concerning capture costs, cloud movement, severe corruption, and confirmation bias remain in Sections 5 and S.3.

D1.justification: Dataset access information, licensing, file organization, preprocessing instructions, and implementation details are unchanged. Both disclose two L40 GPUs, batch size 1, and approximately 3–4 days for DI2FIX training.

R1.justification: The same 108 references and research positioning are retained. Bibliographic differences are citation back-reference page numbers and line wrapping caused by pagination, rather than changes to cited works.

P1.justification: v4 marks Cheng-You Lu and Yi-Shan Hung with dagger contribution symbols and adds a corresponding equal-contribution footnote. The scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Title-page spacing and Figure 1 placement shift, and the abstract moves from spanning pages 1–2 to appearing entirely on page 2. This produces limited text and reference reflow; figure/table content and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 changes contribution notation and pagination while preserving the scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations. Keeping the abstract together is a small layout refinement, but the revision establishes no meaningful overall quality difference.
